allowedOrigins.title: Sites shared with sap-ui-automation
allowedOrigins.description: Chrome match patterns (for example "https://*.s4hana.example.com/*") of sites whose tabs the bridge may share with the local sap-ui-automation, in addition to the sites the user allows in the popup. Users cannot remove these. Ports are ignored unless the pattern names one.

port.title: Relay port
port.description: The one 127.0.0.1 port to connect to (the server's SAP_EXTENSION_PORT). Unset: scan 47823-47830.

pairingCode.title: Pairing code
pairingCode.description: The code the managed servers are started with (SAP_EXTENSION_CODE), so users never pair by hand: 26 Crockford base32 characters (dashes optional). An invalid code is refused and the popup says so. When set it replaces the user's code and the popup cannot change it. Warning: everyone who can read this policy holds the code. On a multi-user host (Remote Desktop Services, Citrix), every user of the host can read it and could run a program that acts as the server for other users' browsers. Do not push a shared code there: let each user pair with their own code. Rotate it by changing the policy and the servers' SAP_EXTENSION_CODE together.
